cr_data.provenance:
(An American Place, New York, NY); Dr. Herman Lorber, New York, NY, 1936; Dr. Stanley H. Lorber, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, gift, 1951; Judy Goffman, New York, NY, 1975; Fenn Galleries, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1978 
(Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive (American Art Research Council Questionnaires), Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Miss O'Keeffe says this is 'East River from the Shelton No. I.' Painted 1926." See cat. nos. 520, 521. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as 'Oil on canvas', Wichita Art Museum lists as 'Oil on linen'. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Wichita Art Museum, 2025)
